jdMd:
## Staff Backend Engineer

IPHIPI is hiring a Staff Backend Engineer to lead the technical direction of our distributed services. You'll architect, build, and operate systems that handle millions of requests per day at low latency.

### Responsibilities
- Own the design of large-scale distributed systems (sharding, consensus, eventual consistency).
- Mentor senior engineers; set technical standards across the backend org.
- Drive observability, reliability, and incident response practices.
- Partner with product on roadmap tradeoffs.

### Must-haves
- 10+ years building production backend systems.
- Deep expertise in at least one of: Java/Kotlin, Go, Rust.
- Hands-on with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Experience designing for scale (sharding, caching, message queues).
- Track record leading technical initiatives.

### Nice-to-haves
- Open-source contributions.
- Experience with Kafka, gRPC, or distributed databases (Spanner, Cassandra, CockroachDB).
- Formal distributed-systems coursework.

must_haves: Java or Kotlin or Go or Rust

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jdMd:
## Senior Frontend Engineer

We're hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build delightful, accessible, performant interfaces. You'll partner with design and product to ship features that millions love using.

### Responsibilities
- Build production React applications with strong TypeScript discipline.
- Champion accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), performance (Core Web Vitals), and UX details.
- Establish frontend architecture patterns and lead code review.
- Collaborate on the design system.

### Must-haves
- 6+ years frontend experience, mostly with React.
- Strong TypeScript fundamentals.
- Experience with Next.js or a similar SSR/RSC framework.
- Track record shipping performant UIs.
- Comfort with modern testing (Playwright, Vitest, RTL).

### Nice-to-haves
- Animation/motion design (Framer Motion, GSAP, WebGL).
- Design systems (Radix, shadcn/ui, headless UI).
- Real-time / streaming UIs.
- Mentoring experience.

title: Senior Data Analyst
jdMd:
## Senior Data Analyst

IPHIPI is hiring a Senior Data Analyst to turn raw product telemetry into the insights that drive every roadmap decision. You'll partner with PMs, designers, and engineers across the company.

### Responsibilities
- Define metrics, build dashboards, and run experiments.
- Translate ambiguous questions into clean SQL and rigorous analysis.
- Communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
- Coach junior analysts.

### Must-haves
- 5+ years analytics experience.
- Expert SQL.
- Experimentation literacy (A/B tests, power, confidence intervals).
- Strong written communication.
- Comfort with at least one BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Mode, Hex).

### Nice-to-haves
- Python or R for analysis.
- dbt and the modern data stack.
- Causal inference techniques.
- Product sense.

title: DevOps Lead
jdMd:
## DevOps Lead

We're looking for a DevOps Lead to own the developer-platform vision: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, reliability, and the inner-loop experience for our 60+ engineers.

### Responsibilities
- Lead a small platform team (3-4 engineers).
- Own Kubernetes, Terraform, and our CI/CD pipelines.
- Drive reliability targets (SLOs, error budgets, incident response).
- Reduce build/test/deploy friction across the org.

### Must-haves
- 7+ years infrastructure / DevOps experience.
- Production Kubernetes operation (not just kubectl, real cluster ops).
- Strong Terraform or Pulumi.
- CI/CD pipeline design (GitHub Actions, Buildkite, or similar).
- Team leadership.

### Nice-to-haves
- Service mesh (Istio, Linkerd).
- Observability stack ownership (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
- FinOps / cloud cost optimization.
- Incident management playbook authorship.

## QA Automation Engineer

IPHIPI is hiring a Senior QA Automation Engineer to help us ship faster and safer. You'll design test architecture and write the tools that other engineers reach for daily.

### Responsibilities
- Design test pyramids spanning unit, integration, and end-to-end.
- Build the test infrastructure that runs on every PR.
- Author and maintain Playwright and API test suites.
- Embed with feature teams to prevent regressions early.

### Must-haves
- 5+ years QA / SDET experience.
- Strong with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
- API testing fundamentals (contract tests, schema validation).
- Programming in TypeScript or Python.
- Test-strategy thinking.

### Nice-to-haves
- Performance / load testing (k6, JMeter).
- Mobile test automation (Appium).
- Chaos engineering exposure.
- Open-source test tools authored.

## Senior Product Manager

IPHIPI is hiring a Senior PM to own a major product surface end-to-end: discovery, strategy, delivery, and measurement.

### Responsibilities
- Define and ship a clear, opinionated product roadmap.
- Run discovery — interviews, prototypes, data dives.
- Partner deeply with engineering and design.
- Define success metrics and ruthlessly measure outcomes.

### Must-haves
- 6+ years PM experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or developer tools.
- Strong product writing and crisp narrative skills.
- Data fluency (you write your own SQL).
- Track record shipping at quality and scale.

### Nice-to-haves
- Engineering background.
- AI/ML product experience.
- 0→1 product launches.
- Public speaking / conference talks.
